headline: Colonial Surge Reclaims Weathered Expanse as Wardens Secure Palantine Berm
war_summary: Colonial forces have staged a dramatic reversal across the Weathered Expanse since the dawn edition, seizing six strongholds and reducing Warden holdings to a lone outpost alongside two devastated ruins, all while enduring over thirteen hundred combined casualties in the latest two hours. Conversely, Warden troops completed their reclamation of Palantine Berm, extinguishing the final Colonial lodgments to secure undisputed mastery across all seven bases amid fierce back-and-forth skirmishing at The Droll. Severe attrition persists in Callahan's Passage, where contested fighting over Crumbling Post left one base neutral and claimed over twelve hundred lives in two hours. To the northeast, Colonials solidified their dominant eight-base grasp in the Stlican Shelf and renewed pressure into Stonecradle, securing eight redoubts after repeated assaults against The Reach. Meanwhile, quiet has largely returned to Callum's Cape and the Nevish Line, though minor clashes briefly flared at Abandoned Ward in Dead Lands and Blackthroat in the Viper Pit.
